name: Refactor Plan
description: Draft a stepwise refactor plan with risk callouts
content:
Draft a refactor plan for the following code.

Goal: {{goal}}

Constraints: {{constraints}}

Current code:
{{code}}

Produce:
1. Target design (1-2 sentence summary).
2. Migration steps in order — each step must be independently mergeable.
3. Test strategy (what to add before / during / after).
4. Rollback plan for each step.
5. Risk callouts and open questions.

variables.name: constraints
variables.description: Must-honour constraints (public API, perf, migration window)
